title: Số điện thoại cũ, mà chẳng ai gọi
style: Cinematic 35mm film still, Asian aesthetic, nostalgic warm tones, emotional documentary realism, soft film grain

scenes.voiceover: Bạn có còn ai để gọi lúc buồn không?
scenes.flow_prompt: Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. Generate exactly 1 image. Cinematic 35mm photograph. A contemplative Asian adult sitting alone by a rain-streaked cafe window at dusk. In front of them on the small dark wooden table sits a cooling cup of black coffee and a silent smartphone. Looking out at the blurry city streetlights through raindrops. Moody solitude, bittersweet nostalgia, poetic film still, 4k photorealistic.

scenes.voiceover: Hồi hai mươi, cả nhóm thức khuya kể chuyện. Giờ mỗi người một thành phố, một gia đình, một nỗi bận.
scenes.flow_prompt: Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. Generate exactly 1 image. Cinematic 35mm film still. A faded vintage film photograph of a group of joyful young Vietnamese university friends sitting around a small plastic tea table at night, laughing genuinely under a dim yellow streetlight. The old photo is resting gently on a modern office wooden desk beside an open laptop. Contrast between past youth and adult solitude, tender memory, 4k photorealistic.

scenes.voiceover: Điện thoại vẫn còn số cũ, nhưng không ai gọi. Không phải hết thương. Chỉ là ai cũng nghĩ: chắc nó bận.
scenes.flow_prompt: Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. Generate exactly 1 image. Cinematic 35mm photograph. Close-up shot of a hand holding a glowing smartphone screen in a dim room at late evening. The phone screen displays an old contact name with a simple portrait thumbnail. The thumb hovers hesitantly over the call button. Intimate, hesitating silence, Wong Kar-wai mood, warm amber and dark cyan palette, 4k photorealistic.

scenes.voiceover: Và thế là mỗi người đều chờ người kia gọi trước. Tình bạn ở tuổi này không tự giữ được.
scenes.flow_prompt: Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. Generate exactly 1 image. Cinematic 35mm film still. Two empty wooden chairs facing each other across a round table in the corner of a quiet rustic Vietnamese cafe in late afternoon. Golden dust motes dancing in shafts of sunlight. Sense of absence, passing time, quiet longing for old companions, artistic composition, 4k photorealistic.

scenes.voiceover: Nó cần một người chịu làm kẻ gọi trước. Hôm nay, hãy làm người gọi trước.
scenes.flow_prompt: Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. Generate exactly 1 image. Cinematic 35mm photograph. Warm medium shot of an Asian adult standing on a breezy balcony at twilight holding a phone to their ear. A gentle, genuine smile spreads across their face as the call connects, soft city lights glowing warmly behind them. Relief, revived friendship, heartwarming closure, 4k photorealistic.
